name: token-atlas
description: Language features for W3C/DTCG design tokens in VS Code: hovers, completion, go-to-definition, rename and validation on token JSON and on exported CSS/Sass/JS, plus an opt-in visual editor.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Token Atlas only reads and edits token files through the workspace API; it runs no workspace code.

tokenAtlas.include.markdownDescription: Globs for files Token Atlas considers as design tokens. Each one is confirmed by a DTCG content check (`$value` / `$type`), so the default of every JSON file finds tokens under any name. Narrow it (e.g. `["tokens/**/*.json"]`) in a very large repo.

tokenAtlas.exclude.markdownDescription: Globs to keep out of workspace token discovery: excluded files do not appear in the Tokens panel, are not offered as alias targets, and raise no cross-file collision warnings. Open one directly and it still gets hovers, validation and the visual editor. The default skips build output and tooling files; setting it replaces that list, and `[]` excludes nothing. JSON files over 2 MB are never scanned.

enumDescriptions: Open token files in the JSON text editor, with Token Atlas's language features.
Open token files in the Token Atlas visual editor.
tokenAtlas.defaultEditor.markdownDescription: Which editor a design-token file opens in. `visual` reopens any JSON file that sniffs as DTCG in the Token Atlas token editor; "Open as JSON" still sends a file back to text for as long as it stays open.

tokenAtlas.rootFontSize.markdownDescription: Root font size in `px`, used to convert between `px` and `rem` in dimension hovers.

enumDescriptions: WCAG 1.4.3 AA, large text (18pt, or 14pt bold): 3:1.
WCAG 1.4.6 AAA, large text (18pt, or 14pt bold): 4.5:1.
WCAG 1.4.11 AA, UI components and graphics: 3:1.
tokenAtlas.contrastTarget.markdownDescription: WCAG 2.2 contrast level that colour hovers and the visual editor's colour preview judge each contrast ratio against, marking it pass or fail.

tokenAtlas.defaultColorSpace.markdownDescription: Colour space new colour tokens are created in, in the visual editor. Existing tokens keep their own space.

tokenAtlas.defaultDimensionUnit.markdownDescription: Unit new dimension tokens are created in, in the visual editor. `rem` values are derived from `#tokenAtlas.rootFontSize#`.

enumDescriptions: One mode at a time, chosen from the toolbar's mode dropdown.
Every mode in its own column, as Figma shows a variable's modes.
tokenAtlas.modeView.markdownDescription: How the visual editor shows a mode file: a file a DTCG resolver modifier lists as one of its contexts, such as `light.tokens.json` under a `theme` modifier. The toolbar toggle changes this setting.

tokenAtlas.validation.markdownDescription: Report DTCG validation problems (unresolved references, reference cycles, malformed values) as diagnostics, and strike through each use of a `$deprecated` token in token files, resolver files and open CSS, Sass, Less, JS and TS files.

tokenAtlas.pathCollisions.markdownDescription: How to report a token path defined in more than one file. The check runs across the whole workspace, so this is a window-level setting. Paths shared only by one DTCG resolver modifier's files (its contexts, such as `light` and `dark`, or the files layered inside one context) are alternatives and never reported; a set file beside them still is. Identical paths across brand or theme files are often deliberate, so the default is `information`; raise it to `warning` or turn it `off`.

tokenAtlas.hardcodedValues.markdownDescription: In CSS, SCSS, Sass and Less, report a colour or `px`/`rem` literal that equals a token in the active set, with a quick fix that replaces it with the token's exported name (`var(--…)`, `$…`, `@…`). Comments and variable definitions are skipped.

tokenAtlas.unusedTokens.markdownDescription: Flag tokens in open token files that no `{reference}` and no CSS, Sass, Less, JS or TS identifier uses. Off by default because it scans every code file in the workspace; `hint` fades the token's name, `information` also lists it in the Problems panel.

tokenAtlas.codeColorSwatches.markdownDescription: Show a color swatch before each use of a color token in CSS, SCSS, Sass, Less, JS and TS (`var(--color-brand-primary)`, `$color-brand-primary`, `tokens.color.brand.primary`), in the color it resolves to in the active set.

tokenAtlas.inlayHints.markdownDescription: Show an inlay hint after each `{reference}` in token JSON, in tokens written inline in a resolver, and after each `var(--token)` in CSS, Sass and Less, with the value it resolves to in the active set (`= #0055ff`, `= 16px`). Hover the hint for the token's card. VS Code's own `editor.inlayHints.enabled` also applies.
